timelines.title: Grand Finale: Muthukumaran Wins Bigg Boss Tamil 8!
timelines.message: In the Grand Finale hosted by Vijay Sethupathi, Muthukumaran Jegatheesan won the Bigg Boss Tamil Season 8 trophy and ₹50 Lakh cash prize! Soundariya Nanjundan finished as Runner-up.

timelines.title: Jacquline Evicted in Cash Task Elimination
timelines.message: Jacquline Lydia was evicted on Day 102 during the cash grab finale challenge, leaving 5 top finalists.

timelines.title: Double Eviction: Arun Prasath & Deepak Dinkar
timelines.message: In the final pre-finale eliminations on Days 97 and 98, Arun Prasath and Deepak Dinkar were evicted.

timelines.title: Double Eviction: Raanav & Manjari
timelines.message: Raanav V C and Manjari Narayanan received the fewest votes and were evicted in a double eviction on Days 90 and 91.

timelines.title: Family Week Commences
timelines.message: The Freeze and Release Family Week task began, as housemates reunited with family members inside the house.

timelines.title: Double Eviction: Jeffry & Anshida
timelines.message: Jeffry and Anshida Akbarsha were evicted in a double eviction on Days 83 and 84.

timelines.title: Rayan Wins Ticket to Finale
timelines.message: Wildcard entrant Rayan won the high-stakes Ticket to Finale tasks, securing immunity and becoming the first official finalist.

timelines.title: Ranjith Evicted
timelines.message: Actor Ranjith got the lowest votes and was evicted from the show on Day 77.

timelines.title: Vishal Wins Week 11 Captaincy; Raanav Re-enters
timelines.message: Vishal won the Week 11 captaincy task. Raanav re-entered the house on Day 72 after receiving medical treatment.

timelines.title: Double Eviction: Sathya SK & Tharshika
timelines.message: Sathya SK and Tharshika received the lowest public votes and were evicted in a double eviction on Days 69 and 70.

timelines.title: Ranjith Wins Week 10 Captaincy
timelines.message: Senior actor Ranjith defeated Deepak, Manjari, and Pavithra in the captaincy task to become Week 10 captain.

timelines.title: Double Eviction: Sachana & RJ Ananthi
timelines.message: In a surprise Weekend Ka Vaar double eviction, Sachana Namidass and RJ Ananthi were evicted together on Day 63.

timelines.title: Jeffry Wins Week 9 Captaincy
timelines.message: Jeffry won the Week 9 captaincy task, securing immunity and leadership.

timelines.title: Shiva Kumar Evicted
timelines.message: Wildcard entrant Shiva Kumar received the lowest public votes and was evicted on Day 56.

timelines.title: Deepak Dinkar Wins Week 8 Captaincy
timelines.message: Deepak Dinkar defeated Pavithra in the captaincy challenge to become Week 8 captain.

timelines.title: Varshini Venkat Evicted
timelines.message: Wildcard contestant Varshini Venkat received the lowest votes and was evicted on Day 49.

timelines.title: Manjari Narayanan Wins Week 7 Captaincy
timelines.message: Wildcard entrant Manjari Narayanan won the captaincy task, beating Vishal to become Week 7 captain.

timelines.title: Riya Thiyagarajan Evicted
timelines.message: Wildcard entry Riya Thiyagarajan got the fewest public votes and was evicted on Day 42.

timelines.title: Arun Prasath Wins Week 6 Captaincy
timelines.message: Arun Prasath defeated Soundariya in the captaincy task to become Week 6 captain.

timelines.title: Sunita Gogoi Evicted
timelines.message: Dancer and TV personality Sunita Gogoi received the lowest public votes and was evicted on Day 35.

timelines.title: Sathya SK Wins Week 5 Captaincy
timelines.message: Sathya SK won the captaincy challenge to become the Week 5 captain.

timelines.title: Diwali Festive Week: No Eviction
timelines.message: Host Vijay Sethupathi announced that no eviction would take place due to Diwali celebrations.

timelines.title: Muthukumaran Wins Week 4 Captaincy
timelines.message: Muthukumaran defeated Ananthi in the "Twist Mela Twist" captaincy task to become Week 4 captain.

timelines.title: Dharsha Gupta Evicted; 6 Wildcard Entrants Enter
timelines.message: Dharsha Gupta was evicted on Day 21. Host Vijay Sethupathi introduced 6 wildcard entrants (Riya, Raanav, Varshini, Manjari, Shiva, Rayan) into the house on Day 28.

timelines.title: Tharshika Wins Week 3 Captaincy
timelines.message: Tharshika defeated Ranjith in the captaincy task to secure her second tenure as house captain.

timelines.title: Arnav Amjath Evicted
timelines.message: Actor Arnav Amjath received the fewest public votes and was evicted on Day 14 during Weekend Ka Vaar.

timelines.title: Sathya SK Wins Week 2 Captaincy
timelines.message: Sathya SK won the "Block la Lock" captaincy task against Deepak, Jacquline, Pavithra, and Soundariya to become Week 2 captain.

timelines.title: Ravindar Evicted; Sachana Re-enters
timelines.message: Producer Ravindar Chandrasekaran was evicted on Day 7 after getting the lowest public votes. Day 1 evicted contestant Sachana Namidass re-entered the house.

timelines.title: Week 1 Open Nominations
timelines.message: Anshida, Arnav, Jacquline, Muthukumaran, Ravindar, Sachana, and Sathya were nominated for the Week 1 eviction process.

timelines.title: Tharshika Becomes Week 1 Captain
timelines.message: Tharshika won the launch captaincy task to become the first house captain of Season 8.

timelines.title: Grand Premiere: Bigg Boss Tamil Season 8 Launch
timelines.message: Actor Vijay Sethupathi debuted as the host for Bigg Boss Tamil Season 8. 18 contestants entered the house (Ravindar, Sachana, Dharsha, Sathya, Deepak, Ananthi, Sunita, Jeffry, Ranjith, Pavithra, Soundariya, Arun, Tharshika, Vishal, Anshida, Arnav, Jacquline, Muthukumaran). On Day 1, Sachana Namidass was evicted by housemates' vote.
